context.hint: Require verified membership before forwarding a configured OIDC group.
context.surface: An identity adapter enriches sessions using configured group names, a user-info claim, and separate project data.
assumptions: The configured names act as a filter over verified membership.

review.invariant: Configured group names may appear in a session only when the identity provider attests membership.
review.verification: Review the session enrichment input and output with a stub identity provider. Assert that attested groups are present and omitted groups are absent.

source_observation.summary: The original enrichment path included an unattested configured group in the session.
